before.children:
<option value="">{t("companies.convHistory.allContacts")}</option>
          {contacts.map((c) => {
            const name = c.display_name || `${c.surname ?? ""} ${c.given_name ?? ""}`.trim() || `#${c.id}`;
            return (
              <option key={c.id} value={String(c.id)}>
                {name}
              </option>
            );
          })}

before.style: {{ fontSize: "var(--font-xs)", padding: "var(--space-1) var(--space-10px)", border: "1px solid var(--border)", borderRadius: "var(--radius-sm)", background: "var(--bg-surface)" }}
